name: Miko Chuu
source:
In a certain mansion there is a certain room, with a shrine built in honor of the Mouse God.
When a multiple-personality shrine maiden is dispatched along with a god who stole that particular name, the adventure game begins...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ067128.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
某座宅邸里有一间特别的房间，里面供奉着鼠神。
一名拥有多重人格的巫女奉命出动，同时还有一位盗用了这个称号的神明同行。冒险就此展开……

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ067128.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
